tile_label_text.title: Tile Label
tile_label_text.description: Text in a small orange label in top-left corner of the tile

tile_hint.title: Tile Hint
tile_hint.description: Small text besides the title of the tile

tile_button_text.title: Tile Button Text
tile_button_text.description: Text on the button in the tile

tile_font_color.title: Tile Font Color
tile_font_color.description: By default, font color from the skin will be used. Specify color in #RRGGBB format to override

tile_background_color.title: Tile Background Color
tile_background_color.description: By default, tile background from the skin will be used. Specify color in #RRGGBB format to override

tile_icon.title: Tile Icon URL
tile_icon.description: Default bundled icon will be used unless you specify an absolute URL to an image here (e.g. a hosted copy of the zones.com favicon)

tile_background_image.title: Tile Background Image URL
tile_background_image.description: By default, this will be a regular flat-colored tile, as per skin. Specify absolute URL to background image to override

target_url.title: Target URL
target_url.description: The URL opened in a new tab when the tile's button is clicked
